weaknesses.title: MEDIAN empty bag returns 0 with OK=1 — silent zero
weaknesses.detail: SYS MEDIAN "" → LAST_N=0 OK=1 COUNT=0. Agents cannot distinguish empty plate from all-zero samples without separate LINES/COUNT check. Program wraps REQUIRE on list empty.

weaknesses.title: SQUEEZE default keeps whitespace-only fields
weaknesses.detail: SQUEEZE without BLANK leaves "  " lines; SUM/AVG skip non-numeric but depth still inflated if agent uses LINES bag not clean. Need SQUEEZE BLANK for intake hygiene.

weaknesses.title: SQUEEZE/MEDIAN/SUM/SORTN do not mutate named bags
weaknesses.detail: Must LET bag = LAST after SQUEEZE or WRITE reintroduces empties. Same non-mutate class.
weaknesses.repro: SQUEEZE b; LINES b still includes empties without LET

weaknesses.title: Even-count MEDIAN is lower mid (not average of two middles)
weaknesses.detail: MEDIAN 10 20 30 40 → 20. Agents expecting statistical mean-of-mids get wrong P50. Documented lower-mid integer policy.

weaknesses.title: PRINT_JSON collapses multi-line sample bags
weaknesses.detail: Sample plate dumps as concatenated numbers. Prefer sum/avg/med scalars.

weaknesses.title: WRITE often omits final trailing newline
NUM only on LAST — observe/seed need PREPEND+HEAD shuttle
weaknesses.detail: Same NUM shuttle tax as budget boards.
